relationships.subject: Nav1.7
relationships.evidence_quote: The complete loss-of-function or knockout (KO) of Scn9a or Scn10a and the conditional KO (cKO) of Scn9a in specific cell populations were shown to decrease sensitivity to various pain stimuli.

relationships.subject: Nav1.8
relationships.evidence_quote: The Possum mutant mice bearing a dominant hypermorphic mutation in Scn10a revealed higher sensitivity to noxious stimuli.

key_findings: Knockout of Scn9a (Nav1.7) or Scn10a (Nav1.8) decreases sensitivity to pain stimuli in rodents.
The Scn10a hypermorphic Possum mutant shows heightened nociceptive sensitivity.
